quarterly_data.signal: Investor presentation (KGI broker conference, May 26, 2026), NT$ million: Q1 2026 revenue 2,980 (+33% QoQ, +30% YoY); gross margin 43% (Q4 2025 42%, Q1 2025 49%); operating margin 26%; net income 699 (+45% QoQ, +14% YoY); EPS NT$19.54. First four months of 2026: revenue by region North America 81%, Taiwan 12%, China 7%; advanced nodes (7nm or equivalent and below) 89% versus mature nodes 11%; by product coaxial sockets 46%, probe cards 27%, PoP and plastic sockets 15%, contact elements 7%, others 3%, burn-in sockets 2%; HPC & AI 68% of revenue by end market. Top-10 customers span AI, HPC, ASIC, CPU, GPU and AP; active customers include IC design houses, CSPs, foundries, ASIC makers, OSATs and IDMs.
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 2026 revenue NT$2,980 million (+30% YoY); North America 81% and HPC & AI 68% of Jan-Apr 2026 revenue

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity expansion (May 26, 2026 deck): spring-probe capacity from 6M pins/month in 2026 H1 to 9M in 2026 H2 and 14M in 2027 H1, to balance insourcing and control critical process technology; socket capacity expands with Renwu Facility I operational from April 2026 and Renwu Facility II breaking ground on May 29, 2026 with operation starting in Q2 2027 (capacity stated in 5,000-pin-equivalent sockets).
quarterly_data.figure: spring probes 6M -> 9M -> 14M pins/month (2026 H1 -> 2027 H1); Renwu Facility II operation Q2 2027

quarterly_data.signal: Products shown in the May 26, 2026 deck: HyperSocket test sockets for ultra-large packages (over 100x100 mm2), over 20K pins, test speed above 224Gbps and heat density above 4000W (HyperSocket-Dual Film, patented); a liquid-cooling socket; the E-Flux6.0 3500W liquid-cooling thermal system, with a device-power roadmap of about 2,500W in 2026, 6,000W in 2028 and 8,000W in 2030; and a co-packaged optics test solution covering PIC / EIC wafer probing, optical engine test sockets and CPO module testing.
